en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5194 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who was struck with a stick and was not released until he was killed. Should the killer be handed over to the heirs of the slain?
Imam (as) said: "Yes, but he should not be left for them to abuse; rather, retribution should be carried out upon him."
